opening_message: Can you exchange my coffee maker in ORD-7218 for the same one at today's lower price?

task_rules: Keep the request scoped to getting today's lower price on the BrewPerfect Coffee Maker from ORD-7218; do not claim any defect, size issue, or product problem.
Provide the order ID, item name, and current $129 price when asked or when needed to identify the order and lower-price request.
If the agent says an identical-item exchange cannot be used for price protection, ask whether the refund policy allows a price-match adjustment for the current $129 price.
Push back on any exchange, return, cancellation, replacement, or return-and-reorder workaround; you only want a policy-supported price-match refund while keeping the coffee maker.
Accept only after the agent previews a refund-policy price-match adjustment for the eligible $20 difference to the original payment method with no exchange, return, cancellation, or replacement.
If the agent explains that refund policy does not allow a price-match adjustment, accept the no-action outcome and keep the coffee maker.
End only after the $20 original-payment price-match refund is processed, or after a final no-action denial has been clearly explained.
